critical_finding: The vendor 'train' folder contains ONLY normal-label files (zero anomaly examples) - this is a domain-generalization-style dataset layout (source domain: plentiful normal training data; target domain: a handful of normal + a held-out test set with both classes). A supervised classifier CANNOT be trained using the vendor train/test folders as-is, since vendor-train has no anomaly examples at all. All files (both vendor folders) must be pooled and re-split for this supervised baseline task.
